Appearance.NotificationIndicatorHint: On tiling window managers (Hyprland, Sway, …) TypeWhisper shows recording as a desktop notification instead of the floating overlay — the overlay would reserve a tile and take keyboard focus away from the window you're dictating into. The notification is styled by your notification daemon (mako, dunst, …), so it matches the rest of your desktop.

Shortcuts.ActivationModeHint: Toggle starts and stops on repeated presses. Push to talk records while held. Hybrid starts immediately, keeps recording after a short press, and stops on release after a long hold.
Shortcuts.AlreadyRunningHint: When TypeWhisper is already running, invoking this command toggles dictation in the existing instance — your shortcut won't launch a second copy.
Shortcuts.AutoSetupHint: Write the dictation shortcut directly to your desktop's settings. The lines below show exactly what will be added — your existing shortcuts are preserved.
Shortcuts.CapabilityMismatchHint: The active backend can only deliver presses, but your activation mode needs release events too. Push-to-talk and Hybrid won't work — switch to Toggle, or enable a backend that supports press+release.
Shortcuts.ComboHint: Use a combination like Ctrl+Shift, Alt+F9, or Ctrl+Shift+Space, or a single side-specific modifier like Right Alt or Left Ctrl.
Shortcuts.CopyLastTranscriptionHint: Optional global shortcut that copies the latest transcription to the clipboard.
Shortcuts.InputGroupBanner: ⚠ Add your user to the input group to enable global hotkeys
Shortcuts.InputGroupBannerHint: On Wayland, TypeWhisper needs read access to /dev/input/event* to detect your dictation key while other apps are focused. Run the command below, then log out and back in.
Shortcuts.MainHotkeyHint: Global shortcut that starts dictation. Its behavior depends on the activation mode below.
Shortcuts.PromptPaletteHint: Optional global shortcut that opens the prompt palette for the current selection without starting dictation. Leave blank to disable it.
Shortcuts.RecentTranscriptionsHint: Optional global shortcut that opens a searchable palette of recent transcriptions.
Shortcuts.ShowCommandsHint: You can bind any key combination to toggle dictation through your desktop's keyboard settings. Set the command to:

Shortcuts.Title: Shortcuts
Shortcuts.TransformSelectionHint: Optional global shortcut for editing selected text by voice. Leave blank to disable it.
Shortcuts.WaylandEvdev: Read keyboard events globally on Wayland
Shortcuts.WaylandEvdevHint: When on, TypeWhisper reads /dev/input/event* so the configured hotkey fires regardless of which window has focus. Disable to fall back to focused-only behavior.
Snippets.EditHint: Double-click a row to edit it. Use tags to keep reusable phrases organized.

TextInsertion.InstallYdotoolFirstHint: ydotool isn't installed yet. Install it through your package manager, then come back here to finish the one-click setup.
TextInsertion.RemoveIntegrationHint: Disables the ydotoold user service and deletes the TypeWhisper-owned udev rule. Rules installed by other tools or by you are left untouched.
TextInsertion.SetUpAutomaticallyHint: TypeWhisper creates a ydotoold user service if your distro doesn't ship one, and grants /dev/uinput access if needed. Granting access runs through pkexec — it asks for your admin password once.
TextInsertion.Subtitle: Control how dictated text reaches your focused app. GNOME and KDE Wayland sessions need ydotool for auto-paste; wlroots compositors (Hyprland, Sway) use wtype; X11 uses xdotool.
TextInsertion.Title: Text insertion
Wizard.ChooseModelDescription: The recommended model runs entirely on your computer — no cloud, no API key. You can add cloud providers later from the Plugins tab.
Wizard.ExtensionsDescription: Enable the plugins you want. Cloud transcription plugins need an API key that you'll enter later from the Plugins tab.
Wizard.FirstDictationDescription: Verify the microphone, paste path, and selected model before finishing setup.
Wizard.HotkeyHint: Accepts Ctrl / Shift / Alt / Meta plus a letter, digit, F-key, Space, Enter, Tab, arrows, etc.
Wizard.IncompleteHint: Go Back to finish those items, or choose Skip to set them up later from Settings.
Wizard.ReadyInstructions: Open any text field, press your hotkey, speak a sentence, then press the hotkey again. TypeWhisper will transcribe locally and type the result into the focused window.
Wizard.ReloginNoticeBody: Setup added you to the 'input' group so the global shortcut can read your keyboard (this is what enables hold-to-talk). Log out of your desktop and back in once to activate it.
Wizard.ReloginNoticeTitle: One more step: log out and back in
Wizard.Subtitle: Speech-to-Text Transcription
Wizard.WritingFocusHint: Optional: pick an industry to enable a matching vocabulary pack on finish.
